statement: Power savings for planar halving lines and k-sets. Improves the planar halving-line bound to $`O(n^{4/3-\varepsilon})`$ for sets with no three collinear and an absolute ε > 0. More generally, an n-point set with no three collinear has $`O(n(k+1)^{1/3-\varepsilon_0})`$ strictly separable k-subsets for $`1\le k\le n/2`$, with an absolute $`\varepsilon_0\gt 0`$. The constants and positive exponents are nonquantitative.
